name: Noctilune
description: A moonlit butterfly Bey whose neon-pink wings bloom through smoky black and deep green armor.

ability.name: Lunar Blossom
ability.description: Whenever Noctilune loses a clash, it gains 1 Lunar Petal (max 5). Each Lunar Petal grants +4% ATK and +4% DEF. At 5 petals, Full Bloom restores 15% max HP, cleanses 1 negative effect, and resets Lunar Petals to 0. Full Bloom can activate twice per battle.

special_move.name: 🌸 Midnight Butterfly
special_move.description: Noctilune releases its stored lunar energy in a butterfly-shaped strike. Deals 150 base damage plus 45% ATK scaling. Each Lunar Petal adds +6% special damage; at 5 petals, Midnight Butterfly also ignores 20% of the opponent's DEF.
flavour_texts: 🌸 **Midnight Butterfly** — moonlit wings bloom across the arena!
